errors.evidence: This part of the description refers to the training (blue) line. The blue line at epoch 11 drops to approximately 45-46%, not 42%. It is the validation (green) line that drops to ~42% at epoch 11.
The description states the validation (green) line starts near 47%. In the plot, the green line starts at approximately 45%, very close to the starting point of the training line.

This phrase provides an interpretation of the data (i.e., the reason for the divergence between training and validation accuracy), which goes beyond a factual description of what is visually represented in the chart.
